declare const count: number;
declare const optional: number | undefined;
declare const title: string;
declare const enabled: boolean;
declare function sideEffect(): void;
declare function takesNumber(value: number | void): string;
type Positive = 1 | 2;
declare const positive: Positive;
export const cases = <>
  {count > 0 && <span>Comparison</span>}
  {Boolean(optional) && <span>Coercion</span>}
  {!!count && <span>Double negation</span>}
  {title && <span>Text gate</span>}
  {positive && <span>Nonzero literals</span>}
  {count ? <span>Conditional test</span> : null}
  {(count && <span>Fallback removes zero</span>) || null}
  {takesNumber(count && sideEffect())}
  <button onClick={() => count && sideEffect()} data-count={count && 'present'}
    disabled={count && enabled} title={count && title}>Action</button>
  <button onClick={() => count && <span>Discarded callback result</span>}
    data-render={() => count && <span>Ordinary attribute</span>}>Action</button>
</>;
